about: Agreed labels for the repin meaning check (SR-111): does the change of one stale link leave everything the requirement relies on as it was? 'pin': 'HEAD' means the label was made against the link's pin as committed at HEAD, not a pin refreshed in the working tree since.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: review.py only adds a 'judging unavailable: <cause>' variant of the triage-unavailable line. Resolve, plain-word commands, candidate listing and the answer content are untouched.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: The cli.py route table adds stale/understand/settle/undo/go, reroutes clarify and edits the help text. ID reservation is untouched.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: write_snapshot gains an optional failures count (understand_failures). The overlap warning data and status line are untouched.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: capture_helpers.py only adds a CoverageJudge test double and use_coverage_judge. Existing helpers are unchanged.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: The test's skill-text assertion is tightened ('iaso relay` is refused'). The settings, deny-rule and marker checks that EX-2 relies on are untouched.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: Diffed against the HEAD pin (the working-tree pin was already refreshed). config.py changes the judgment default, adds verify.coverage, hooks.stale_holds_max and UnderstandConfig. trace.exempt and the untraced mechanics are untouched.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: contracts.py adds SP8 dataclasses, new ApprovalBy and SelectionReason literals and 'none' backend defaults. TurnEvent and TurnOutput (agent_context, owner_lines, block, status_line) are unchanged.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: Diffed against the HEAD pin. verify/cli.py adds 'tests map --coverage', selection reason words and notes lines. Nothing touches approve/relay refusal or tests waive.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: cli.py routing changes (stale, the understand commands, clarify rerouted, help text). merge-check and validate routing are unchanged.

items.label: changed
items.why: test_approvals.py deletes every relay test, including test_relay_ok_naming_records_confirms_only_those, which checked EX-7 (mixed 'SR-001 is ok but ... wrong' refused, SR-001 alone confirmed). EX-7 is no longer tested.

items.label: changed
items.why: early.py swaps get_backend for optional_backend and drops the heuristic fallback ('JEV when configured, else the heuristic' becomes 'the configured judge'). The 'a quick word check' label is removed. The statement's fallback and EX-8's word-check backend no longer exist.

items.label: changed
items.why: test_relay_mixed.py is retired: the EX-1..EX-5 tests are replaced by a test that the relay is refused for every case. EX-1 (relaying INT-006 confirms it) is no longer true or checked.

items.label: changed
items.why: The EX-3 test now uses a scripted Judge({}) that answers benign for every prompt, so 'tidy docstring gives no flag' is tautological rather than checked against the real judge. EX-4's precision fixture now goes to xfail instead of asserting.

items.label: changed
items.why: test_relay_reject.py is retired: the EX-3 test (an unknown reason is recorded as intent-change) is gone and replaced by 'relay refused, nothing recorded'. Rejection relay no longer exists.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: Same cli.py route/help diff. clarify now routes to understand.cli, but per cmd_clarify's docstring the non --wait path is the unchanged clarification helper. The claims register is untouched.

items.label: changed
items.why: commands.py's cmd_relay is gutted to always refuse (EXIT_REFUSED). The statement's 'iaso relay --set with the owner's affirming words writes one approval' no longer works.

items.label: changed
items.why: The EX-2 test no longer checks that '/iaso confirm SR-002' confirms SR-002. It only asserts the output says 'you confirm nothing yourself' and has no 'iaso relay'. The confirmation the example describes is no longer checked.

items.label: changed
items.why: test_align.py replaces the heuristic test: it now asserts backend 'none', edges 'unjudged' with score None, and 'judging unavailable'. The statement's 'with the heuristic it labels overlap scores' is removed. The EX-2 test itself is not in the diff.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: judgment/cli.py catches JudgmentUnavailable: the packet is built without a score and jev status reports backend 'none' with a notice. It still reports configured and key state without the secret. The heuristic was already excluded by EX-1.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: report.py only passes core= to checked_entries in the members-confirmed check. The one-process, write-nothing and 10-row cap behaviour is untouched.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: test_review.py switches to the legacy_relay helper and changes the triage assertion to 'judging unavailable'. Nothing in SR-064's resolve/plain-words examples is affected.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: test_glance.py writes agent-relayed entries via legacy_relay (the same payload shape) instead of approvals.relay. The glance assertions are unchanged, and the EX-2 auto-jev part is not in the diff.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: Only the assertion that 'keep feat-x's but change the title' is refused was removed, which is not part of EX-7. The EX-7 test (ok DEC, keep feat-x's maps to feat-x, bare ok refused) is unchanged.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: The same tightened skill-text assertion. The settings, hooks, marker and deny-rule idempotence checks for EX-1 are unchanged.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: confirm.py adds re-checks for owner-words/settled/command approvals and threads core through. Pinning of verified_by ends and the acceptance-test-changed/hidden-regression logic are unchanged.

items.label: unchanged
items.why: session_start.py adds a timing aid, a background test-map build, a cached triage offer and passes auto_approve=off to build_snapshot. The status card's rendering, counts, 'by JEV' and ASCII form are untouched.
